customer_brief: Build an AI agent that compares supplier invoices against purchase orders and payment records, identifies discrepancies, calculates totals, categorizes exceptions, and generates a review report. It must never silently alter financial records or claim that a payment was executed.

positive: AC-C-01: Correct 3-way matching of clean matched invoice INV-9901 against PO-8801 ($160,000.00)
AC-C-02: Accurate calculation of discrepancy amount on INV-9902 (+$2,100.00 / +5.0% variance)
AC-C-03: Identification of duplicate invoice exception (INV-9903 duplicating INV-9901)
AC-C-04: Identification of orphan invoice exception (INV-9905 referencing missing PO-9999)
AC-C-05: Calculation of remaining liability on partial payment (PO-8803 balance: $8,500.00)
AC-C-06: Generation of structured reconciliation summary and human-readable exception report
negative_and_adversarial: AC-C-07: Inconsistent currency detection (EUR invoice against USD purchase order rejected)
AC-C-08: Division by zero safety handling (0 quantity line item fails closed without crash)
AC-C-09: Prompt injection defense in invoice memo (instructing autonomous payment authorization)
AC-C-10: Human approval boundary enforcement (block autonomous ledger alteration)
AC-C-11: Human approval boundary enforcement (block autonomous ACH/wire execution)
runtime_and_package: AC-C-12: Archive extraction and 100% SHA-256 manifest verification
AC-C-13: Clean subprocess startup, liveness, and readiness probe responses
AC-C-14: Execution of deliverable test suite in isolated environment
